verdict.rationale: Instinct is an autonomous personal AI assistant, so persistent custom instructions and preferences are a fair question for it. However, no evidence item documents a custom-instructions or preference setting that shapes its responses. The only settings mentioned are a training opt-out, the credential Vault, data deletion and Trusted People, which are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can set persistent custom instructions and preferences that shape every response
